lines.text: Okay, so. Long drive. Two minutes in, and from the back seat: "Papa, phone do na!"
lines.show: Okay, so. Long drive. Two minutes in, and from the back seat: "Papa, phone do na!"

lines.text: But nope! No phone. We hand him Cheeko.
lines.show: But nope! No phone. We hand him Cheeko.

lines.text: Stories, rhymes, games. And look at that face! (laughs)
lines.show: Stories, rhymes, games. And look at that face!

lines.text: (sighs) Then it's the same rhyme. Same car. Forty-seventh time.
lines.show: Then it's the same rhyme. Same car. 47th time.

lines.text: And then Papa goes, wait! Cheeko has a headphone jack!
lines.show: And then Papa goes, wait! Cheeko has a headphone jack!

lines.text: Headphones on. Rhymes in. Total do not disturb mode. (laughs)
lines.show: Headphones on. Rhymes in. Total do not disturb mode.

lines.text: He gets every story. And we get our drive back.
lines.show: He gets every story. And we get our drive back.

lines.text: Well, almost. (sighs) Now the only noise in the car is Papa's singing.
